description: Werkelijk rendement, end-of-term sale in 2030: realised gain over the gemiddelde verkrijgingsprijs taxed at 36%, after the indexed heffingsvrij resultaat and a carried-forward verlies
source: Hand calculation from the bill text: Wet werkelijk rendement box 3, Kamerstukken 36 748 nr. 2 (https://zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl/kst-36748-2.html: art. 2.13, 5.1, 5.2, 5.40, 5.65, 5.67, VI) as amended by novelle 37 053 nr. 2 (https://www.tweedekamer.nl/downloads/document?id=2026D55225: art. 5.26, 5.32). No official calculator exists (#16).
derivation: 2029: step-up to the 1 January value 100.000 (first werkelijk year), plus 12.000 bought → verkrijgingsprijs 112.000; the value rises to 120.000, unrealised. Resultaat = −500 DUO interest; the heffingsvrij resultaat only applies to a positive resultaat (art. 5.2), so the inkomen −500 is a verlies, carried forward in full (art. 5.65/5.67; the € 500 drempel is left out, #7). Tax 0. Had the pot been sold at the end of 2029: realised 120.000 − 112.000 = 8.000; resultaat 7.500; inkomen 7.500 − 1.800 = 5.700; tax 36% × 5.700 = 2.052 → realisation tax 2.052 − 0 = 2.052. 2030: at the start 5% of the pot is sold for 6.000; gemiddelde verkrijgingsprijs (art. 5.26) 5% × 112.000 = 5.600 → realised 400, remaining verkrijgingsprijs 106.400. The pot ends the term at 114.000 + 10.000 = 124.000 and is treated as sold (art. 5.32): realised 124.000 − 106.400 = 17.600. Resultaat 400 + 17.600 = 18.000. Heffingsvrij resultaat indexed from the year after the start (art. VI): 1.800 × 1,02 = 1.836 → inkomen 16.164; minus the 500 verlies (art. 5.1) → 15.664; tax 36% × 15.664 = 5.639,04 → 5.639. Without the deemed sale: resultaat 400, within the heffingsvrij resultaat → tax 0, so the realisation tax is 5.639.
